
 Usage: openajar local [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 openajar on this computer: it serves your agents (Claude Code, Codex) and
 rents a cloud VM only while an agent has an environment open.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ serve    Run the local node in the foreground (the service runs this).       │
│          Ctrl-C stops it.                                                    │
│ start    Start the local node as a service (launchd on macOS, systemd on     │
│          Linux), now and at every login.                                     │
│ stop     Stop the local node. It stays stopped, also after a restart, until  │
│          `openajar local start`.                                             │
│ restart  Start the running local node again, so it runs the openajar         │
│          installed now: same home, same port.                                │
│ status   Is it running, on which port, which environments are open, and what │
│          it closed after a sleep.                                            │
│ logs     The end of the local node's log.                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
